text:
tara-support: FYI ACME reported a sudden p99 spike ~30m after the midnight deploy, lots of timeouts and a few 502s. They say it started right after auth token refreshes began failing for some tenants. @samir-sre can you take a look?

samir-sre: on it. can you paste a sample request id / curl? also any tenant id so i can filter logs quickly

tara-support: repro curl below (sanitized). tenant acme-42
```
curl -v -H 'Authorization: Bearer <redacted>' \
  -d '{"prompt":"hi"}' \
  https://api.redwood-inference/realtime/v1/gen
```
we're seeing `ERR_TIMEOUT (batcher:hold-window)` and `rpc deadline exceeded` in the node logs.

leo-custsuc: customer says p95 was fine but p99 jumped from 420ms -> 1.8s. They run high qps with many tiny prompts.

samir-sre: that error string points to the continuous-batcher hold-time heuristics. anything changed in the last deploy? @julia-platform

julia-platform: pushed a batching tweak in the midnight deploy to raise `grace_window_ms` from 50 -> 200 to reduce requests-per-token cost for mostly-large prompts. release id: rel-2026-03-17-0123. deploy-bot: rolled to 3 regions at 00:08 UTC.

deploy-bot: Deploy rel-2026-03-17-0123 to prod completed. changelist: batching/grace_window increase. CI: green.

samir-sre: aha. tiny prompts + larger grace window => more requests waiting in head-of-queue leading to long tail when those tiny requests block a batch. quick mitigation: revert grace_window for the small-tenant cohort or add `min_batch_size` logic for tenants with high tiny-prompt ratio.

tara-support: can we hotfix revert for acme-42 now? they are getting angry.

samir-sre: yes. two options: 1) rollback global change (blunt) 2) patch routing: set `grace_window_ms:50` for tenant acme-42 via runtime routing override. i'll do (2) first. patch command: 
```
PATCH /configs/batcher/overrides/acme-42
{ "grace_window_ms": 50 }
```
I'll apply to region-us-east-1 first.

julia-platform: logging note - enable `batcher.trace=tenant` for 1 minute to capture per-tenant batch composition (will add noise).

samir-sre: applied override to us-east-1 -> echoed config: `grace_window_ms=50` for acme-42. watching metrics.

(30s later)

samir-sre: metrics: p99 dropped from 1.8s -> 520ms in us-east-1 for acme-42. requests per batch increased slightly but tail reduced.

leo-custsuc: customer confirmed latency improved for a subset of requests. they want whole-region fix.

tara-support: customer also reported a couple of `401` intermittents around same time. might be unrelated but noted.

samir-sre: 401s were likely the token refresh auth cascade; separate ticket. for batching tail: propose a small rollout plan: revert global grace_window change and instead ship a heuristic: increase grace window only when median prompt length > 128 tokens OR use per-tenant traffic profile. we'll draft RFC.

julia-platform: agree. temporary mitigation: schedule a rollback for rel-2026-03-17-0123 in 2h if we don't see regressions in other tenants. i'll prepare the rollback playbook.

samir-sre: adding repro steps to the incident ticket: 1) run a tight tiny-prompt load (qps ~ 150) against a single tenant 2) watch `batcher.histogram.batch_size` and `batcher.histogram.hold_time_ms` 3) observe tail p99 jump when grace_window>100ms with high tiny-prompt ratio. include script: 
```
# tiny load generator (example)
for i in `seq 1 500`; do
  curl -s -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -d '{"prompt":"ok"}' https://api.../gen &
done
wait
```

tara-support: i'm updating the customer: we patched their region and we're working on a safer rollout; will link them the mitigation steps + timeline.

leo-custsuc: they want postmortem with root cause + config guidance. can we add a short checklist for support runbooks?

samir-sre: yes. checklist draft: - check recent batching config changes - identify tenant tiny-prompt ratio - apply tenant override `grace_window_ms` or `min_batch_size` - monitor p95/p99 and batch size distribution - if global revert needed, coordinate with platform for rollback window.

julia-platform: posting RFC link when ready. filing follow-up PR to make grace_window conditional on prompt-length histogram.

tara-support: thanks team. closing on thread for now, will reopen if customer sees new issues. :thumbsup:
